note: USA targets are strategic and deliberately aggressive, Hutong NYC explicitly so, and Hutong Miami's GA4 target is derived from its Meta plan (monthly × 6738/4756). Read variance to target with that in mind. The USA booked 390 GA4 bookings, down 13.9 percent week on week and down 56.1 percent year on year, with all three venues below target and below last year. Aqua NYC is the sharpest: users are 22.9 percent below last year but bookings are 67.1 percent below, with conversion at 3.6 percent against 8.4 percent last year. Hutong NYC and Hutong Miami each lost about 41 percent of their users year on year. Year to date the portfolio sits 50.4 percent behind a target that assumed growth. Note also that the Google Reserve to OpenTable shift at both US Hutongs is a routing and margin change, not lost demand — the covers report carries the fuller picture.
